capabilities: Insert a bullet point when a line starts with a space or tab
Toggle automatic bullets on or off in settings
Control half-width spaces, full-width spaces, and tabs separately
intentEvidence: This plugin is inspired by the automatic bullet point feature in Cosense.
problem: Obsidian does not convert leading spaces or tabs into list bullets as you type, so users must type the dash character themselves.

relations.evidence: inspired by the automatic bullet point feature in Cosense

summary: Typing assistant that automatically inserts a bullet point ("- ") when you start a line with a space, full-width space, or tab.
